closure_definition: homepage entry center prototype: trigger=user opens the prototype or selects an entry intent; core behavior=present login method switching, renewal prompt, download entry, support entry, announcement display, and responsive shell; observable result=the selected entry state and prototype_only/not_integrated boundary are visible without invoking real production capability
trigger: user opens the homepage entry center prototype or selects login, renewal, download, support, or announcement entry intent
core_behavior: present the homepage entry center as a prototype-only surface for login method switching, renewal prompt, download entry, support entry, announcement display, and desktop/mobile responsive review
observable_result: user can identify each entry intent and see prototype feedback while all real backend-facing capability remains marked prototype_only or not_integrated

protected_behaviors: the prototype must not perform real login, real renewal payment, real client download, real support integration, real backend calls, telemetry, auth, release, or rollback
all backend-facing behavior must remain explicitly prototype_only or not_integrated
business_constraints: UNIT-1 is the only phase unit and must be fully consumable by design, test-design, developer, QA, and delivery-owner
AS-IS evidence ids QFT-ASIS-001, QFT-ASIS-002, and QFT-ASIS-003 must be preserved for traceability

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户可以在密码登录、验证码登录和扫码登录之间切换，并看到对应的原型状态。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户依次选择 password、verification-code、QR login tabs
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 选中方式高亮，相关输入或扫码说明切换显示，并出现 prototype_only/not_integrated 边界提示。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 连续快速切换登录方式后，只保留最后一次选择的可见状态。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 登录方式切换无反馈，或让用户误以为真实登录已经接入。

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户可以看到续费提示，并能在原型中确认或收起提示。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击续费提示的确认或收起控件
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 提示状态变化可见，并保留 prototype_only/not_integrated 边界。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 提示已收起后再次操作不会产生布局错乱。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 续费提示不可操作，或暗示真实支付已经接入。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real renewal payment is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户可以识别客户端下载入口，点击后看到原型反馈。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击客户端下载入口
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 原型展示下载入口反馈，并明确 not_integrated。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 重复点击下载入口只更新原型反馈，不触发真实下载。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 入口不可识别，或触发真实下载/外部跳转。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real client download is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户可以识别联系客服入口，点击后看到原型反馈。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击联系客服入口
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 原型展示客服入口反馈，并明确 not_integrated。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 移动视口下客服入口仍可识别且不遮挡登录区域。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 入口不可识别，或触发真实客服系统。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real support system is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户可以看到公告或提示入口的基础展示。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户查看入口中心公告区域
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 公告或提示内容在桌面和移动视口中可见，不覆盖核心入口。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 公告内容较长时仍保持入口区域可读。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 公告不可见、遮挡核心入口，或暗示真实公告后台已接入。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real announcement backend is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 入口中心在桌面和移动视口下都能保持核心入口可识别。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: QA 分别用 desktop 1440x1000 和 mobile 390x844 视口打开原型
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 登录、续费、下载、客服和公告入口均可识别，文本不重叠，核心操作不被遮挡。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 移动视口宽度较小时，入口内容换行或重排但不溢出。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 移动端文本溢出、遮挡、入口丢失，或桌面端信息层级混乱。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: production responsive release is not integrated

verification_plan.business_operation: open the prototype, switch login modes, operate renewal prompt, and click download/support/announcement entries
verification_plan.expected_observation: each AC has visible prototype feedback and every backend-facing action remains marked prototype_only or not_integrated
verification_plan.evidence_target: desktop and mobile browser screenshots plus interaction notes

options: login-first layout with auxiliary action rail
task-centered dashboard grouping login, renewal, download, support, and announcement equally
design_decision_candidates.constraints: must preserve prototype_only and not_integrated boundaries while keeping desktop and mobile entry recognition clear
design_decision_candidates.design_handoff: choose layout and interaction states without adding production backend integration

exclusions: UNIT-1 does not implement real login, renewal payment, client download, support integration, announcement backend, telemetry, auth, release, or rollback
UNIT-1 does not prove production readiness for the real 全房通 system
priority_basis: UNIT-1 is the only product unit for phase-1 and gates all downstream design, test-design, developer, QA, and signoff work
